---
name: Method feedback
about: Feedback on the training method itself—clean-pass rule, advancement rule, session template, stage progression, tracking format, or any other rule in approach.md.
title: "[method] "
labels: method
---

## Which part of the method

Point at the specific section of [approach.md](../approach.md) or [chapter-01.md](../chapter-01.md) you are commenting on. A §-number or a quoted sentence is ideal.

## What you observed or want to challenge

The rule as written, and what it looked like in practice (or where you think it will fail in practice). Concrete beats abstract—an example session or scenario is worth ten adjectives.

## What you would change

If you have a proposed alternative, state it. If you are flagging the problem without a fix in mind, that is also fine—say so explicitly.

## Your context (optional but useful)

Rough experience level with double bass drumming; whether you are following the manual yourself or reviewing it dry. This is not a gate—it just helps calibrate how to read your feedback.
